items.question: Which additional iconographic features complete the described form of Kālāgnirudra?
premises: The described form is endowed with red upward-standing hair.
The described form is situated upon a lion throne.
These attributes further specify the iconography of Kālāgnirudra.
items.inference: Kālāgnirudra's manifestation is defined by these additional physical and positional marks.
items.plain_english: Endowed with red, upward-standing hair, and seated upon a lion throne.
